description: The master list of all fantasy league managers (owners). Use this to find an owner's ID from their name and vice versa.
Contains high-level metadata about each season (year). Use this to find the champion of a specific year or to get a season_id from a year.

Contains one row for each team in a specific season. This is the critical link between an owner, a team, and a season. Contains the final standing for the team for the specific year. Use this table when answering questions about finish positions or final standings.
Contains every single pick from every fantasy draft. Use for questions about draft position, who drafted a player, etc.

Contains every head-to-head game played. This is the primary source for weekly scores, wins, and losses between teams. Use this for questions about a specific week or matchup. Includes information about playoff, regular season, and championship matches.
The master list of all individual NFL players in the database. Use this table to find a player's ID from their name.
The master list of all 32 NFL teams. Use this to map an nfl_team_id to its full name (e.g., 'GB' to 'Green Bay Packers').
Contains seasonal (full-season) statistics for Quarterback (QB) players. Use for questions about a QB's performance over an entire season.
Contains seasonal (full-season) statistics for Running Back (RB) players. Use for questions about an RB's performance over an entire season.
Contains seasonal (full-season) statistics for Wide Receiver (WR) players. Use for questions about a WR's performance over an entire season.
Contains seasonal (full-season) statistics for Tight End (TE) players. Use for questions about a TE's performance over an entire season.
Contains seasonal (full-season) statistics for Kicker (K) players. Use for questions about a Kicker's performance over an entire season.
Contains seasonal (full-season) statistics for Defense/Special Teams (DST). Use for questions about a DST's performance over an entire season.
Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Quarterback (QB) players. Use for questions about a QB's performance in a single game or week.
Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Running Back (RB) players. Use for questions about an RB's performance in a single game or week.
Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Wide Receiver (WR) players. Use for questions about a WR's performance in a single game or week.
Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Tight End (TE) players. Use for questions about a TE's performance in a single game or week.
Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Kicker (K) players. Use for questions about a Kicker's performance in a single game or week.
Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Defense/Special Teams (DST). Use for questions about a DST's performance in a single game or week.
A comprehensive analysis view combining draft data with player performance. Use this for advanced questions about draft value, steals, and busts.
Provides a detailed, side-by-side view of every head-to-head matchup, including team names, owner names, and scores for both sides. Best for direct win/loss questions between two specific owners.
Provides the final regular season standings for each team in each season. This view EXCLUDES playoff games and is the definitive source for regular season records and points.

A summary view that aggregates career statistics for each fantasy owner. Each row represents one owner's entire league history. This is the best table for questions about all-time records and rankings.
